name: Injury
overview: Scripture recognizes the reality and seriousness of injury, emphasizing just consequences as seen in Exodus 21:23's principle of life for life. God promises restoration and healing for wounds, both physical and spiritual, as declared in Jeremiah 30:17. Believers are encouraged to seek the Lord earnestly, trusting in His power to reveal hidden truths and bring healing, exemplified in Jeremiah 33:3 and Acts 19:12. Wisdom also counsels restraint and self-control, which can prevent further harm, reflecting the importance of guarding one's words and actions as taught in Proverbs 29:11.
